messages:
eldridge: customer hit a weird onboarding flow: they completed signup, used the docker quickstart, saw a successful first response in the UI, then after adding a card the sample started returning 402 on /v1/generate. console showed "trial credits applied" during signup. anyone seen this?

yun: can you grab the sample app env + raw request/response headers? need x-request-id and any billing headers.

eldridge: pasted minimal repro from the container:
```
# env per README
export SAMPLE_API_KEY=sk-temp-xyz
# sample loads REDWOOD_KEY in code
python quickstart.py
```
first call: 200 OK
second call (after payment): 402 Payment Required
headers: x-request-id=req_91a, x-billing-state=pending_verification, x-retry-policy=default
body: {"error":"payment_required","hint":"verify payment method"}

harper: two separate issues here we've been tracking: (A) onboarding creates a transient trial credit that the UI marks applied while processor callbacks are still pending; (B) quickstart env var names differ across repos and some sample code reads REDWOOD_KEY/REDWOOD_API_KEY while README shows SAMPLE_API_KEY -> leads to token swaps when users regenerate keys.

yun: also noticed our SDK default retry logic (js v1.4.0 / py v2.1.0) will retry certain 4xx when combined with header x-retry-policy: default. 402 should not be retried for non-idempotent endpoints. we should make 402 terminal for generate/completions endpoints.

eldridge: workaround we gave customer: regenerate the service account key after payment clears and restart the sample container. that restored 200 responses. i'll add to support KB.

harper: short-term actions: (1) docs - standardize env var name to REDWOOD_API_KEY across all quickstarts (owner: harper, eta: today); (2) samples - add a preflight /v1/billing_status check that prints friendly msg if billing_state != active (owner: devex, eta: next week); (3) sdk - patch retry policy so 402 is not retried on non-idempotent endpoints (owner: yun, eta: 48h).

onboard-bot: created INF-5050: "onboarding quickstart: billing preflight + SDK retry mask 402" assigned to yun. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-5050

support: update playbook: ask for x-request-id, org id, sample env var names, and whether they used the generated service key. recommend regen+restart as workaround.

yun: I'll also add a temporary SDK debug flag to log when a 4xx gets retried so we can dogfood and catch incorrect retries quickly. opt-in for next week.

eldridge: thanks — looping customer back now. will post result once they confirm it's fixed.
